date.note: The Commons filename and date field say 1959, with no support for the 1 January day. The discography identifies a 1958 session with the same soloist, conductor and orchestra. The carrier underlying the Commons file has not been independently matched, so both dates remain visible.

recording.value: Rule 3 — territorial: sound recording public domain in the European Union (pre-1963 publication basis).
recording.note: Commons applies PD-EU-audio to Richter/Rowicki’s DG recording attributed to 1959. The dossier preserves the competing 1958 session attribution; both precede 1963. Usable under the programme’s pre-1963 European sound-recording rule; the former 50-year term had expired before the 2013 extension. This is territorial, not a worldwide licence; US sound-recording status is not established. A recording date alone is not represented as an independently verified first-publication date.
